description:
Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

This subsidy program supports small business owners by providing financial assistance for efforts like market expansion based on a sustainable business plan you create, as well as operational efficiency improvements done alongside those efforts.

At this information session, we'll explain the subsidy system and share real-world examples in easy-to-understand terms. Our advisors will help guide you through the application process, so please join us and put this opportunity to good use. For details and to apply, please see the flyer below.

【Responsible Division】
Small and Medium Enterprise Consultation Office

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2422/
